description: Google Forms API - Create forms, add questions, collect responses, analyze data. V2 includes SMART BUNDLED TOOLS for efficient operations.
critical_fixes: Nov 2025: Two-step form creation (title only → batchUpdate) to comply with API restrictions
Nov 2025: Removed response_format parameter from AI functions for universal OpenAI model compatibility
Nov 2025: Properly handles description and documentTitle via batchUpdate (fixes HTTP 400 errors)
authentication_notes: Google Forms API requires OAuth user credentials (not service accounts). Use http://localhost:5001/api/auth/google/login?user_id=X to authenticate.

tools.name: google_forms_create_complete_form
tools.description:
Example response:
Created: **New Document**
- ID: `abc123`
- URL: https://example.com/doc/abc123
- Link: [New Document](https://example.com/doc/abc123)

⭐ PREFERRED METHOD: Create a complete Google Form with all questions in ONE operation. Much more efficient than calling create_form + add_question multiple times. Form is automatically shareable.

questions.description: List of questions to add. Each question is an object with: type (text|paragraph|multiple_choice|checkbox|dropdown|linear_scale), text (question text), options (array, for choice questions), required (boolean), low_value/high_value/low_label/high_label (for linear_scale)

shareable.description: Make form accessible to anyone with the link

collect_email.description: Require responders to provide email addresses

returns.description: Complete form details with responder_uri (shareable link), edit_uri (edit link), form_id, and questions_added count

tools.usage_notes: This is the MOST EFFICIENT way to create forms. Use this instead of separate create + add_question calls. The form is automatically shareable by default.

tools.name: google_forms_ai_generate_form
tools.description:
Example response:
Read 45 rows from **Sales Spreadsheet**
- ID: `xyz789`
- URL: https://example.com/sheet/xyz789
- Data: [actual data read]

⭐ AI-POWERED: Generate a complete form from natural language description. AI determines appropriate questions, types, and options automatically. Perfect when you're not sure what questions to ask.

prompt.description: Natural language description of the form you want to create
prompt.example: Create a restaurant feedback survey with questions about food quality, service speed, cleanliness, value for money, and likelihood to return. Include ratings and open-ended questions.

shareable.description: Make form accessible to anyone with the link

returns.description: Complete form with responder_uri (link to share), questions_count, and AI generation details

tools.usage_notes: Use this when the user describes what they want in natural language. AI will determine the best questions, types, and options. Requires OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable.
tools.implementation_notes: OPENAI COMPATIBILITY FIX (Nov 2025): Uses prompt engineering ('Return ONLY valid JSON') instead of response_format parameter for universal model compatibility. Works with gpt-4, gpt-3.5-turbo, and other OpenAI models.

tools.name: google_forms_bulk_create_multiple
tools.description:
Example response:
Created: **New Document**
- ID: `abc123`
- URL: https://example.com/doc/abc123
- Link: [New Document](https://example.com/doc/abc123)

⭐ BULK OPERATION: Create multiple complete forms at once. Most efficient for creating many forms with similar structure (e.g., event registrations for different locations).

forms_configs.description: List of form configurations. Each config is an object with: title, description (optional), questions (array of question objects), collect_email (boolean)

shareable.description: Make all forms accessible to anyone with the link

returns.description: Array of all created forms with their responder URIs and details

tools.usage_notes: Use this when creating 2+ forms at once. Much more efficient than creating forms one by one.

tools.name: google_forms_create_form
tools.description:
Example response:
Created: **New Document**
- ID: `abc123`
- URL: https://example.com/doc/abc123
- Link: [New Document](https://example.com/doc/abc123)

Create a basic Google Form (empty, no questions). NOTE: Use google_forms_create_complete_form instead for better efficiency.

IMPORTANT - API COMPLIANCE (Nov 2025 Fix):
- Uses two-step process: (1) Create with title only, (2) Add description via batchUpdate
- This complies with Google Forms API restriction: "Only info.title can be set when creating a form"
- Description and documentTitle are added via separate batchUpdate call if provided

title.description: Form title (REQUIRED - only field allowed during creation)

description.description: Form description (added via batchUpdate after creation)

document_title.description: Document title in Google Drive (defaults to form title, added via batchUpdate)

shareable.description: Make form accessible to anyone with link

returns.description: Form with form_id, responder_uri (link to share), edit_uri, and shareability status

tools.implementation_notes: Two-step API process: (1) forms().create() with title only, (2) forms().batchUpdate() for description/documentTitle. This fixes HTTP 400 errors from Nov 2025.

creating_forms.preferred_method: Use google_forms_create_complete_form - it creates the form with all questions in ONE call
creating_forms.ai_method: Use google_forms_ai_generate_form when the user describes what they want in natural language
creating_forms.bulk_method: Use google_forms_bulk_create_multiple when creating 2+ forms at once

best_practices: Always use smart bundled tools (google_forms_create_complete_form) instead of create + add_question multiple times
Forms are shareable by default - no need to set permissions manually
Use AI generation when user provides a description rather than specific questions
Use bulk operations when working with multiple forms or questions
Check response count with google_forms_get_responses before analyzing
